# 佛說如來智印經

**ID:** T0633
**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 420–479
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0633

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T633 (one fascicle, alt. title 諸佛慧法身經; provisional Sanskrit *Tathāgatajñānamudrāsamādhi-sūtra*) is an anonymously transmitted Chinese version of the same Indic *sūtra* underlying [T632](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0269) (Zhī Qiān's *Huì-yìn sānmèi*) and [T634](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0271) (the Northern Song *Dàshèng zhì-yìn jīng*). The text is conventionally placed in the Liú-Sòng (420–479) on stylistic grounds, but the translator is already lost in the *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145).

**Abstract**

T633 has the alternate title 諸佛慧法身經 (*Sūtra on the Wisdom-Dharmakāya of All Buddhas*), recorded in the Sēngyòu catalog. The translator is anonymous; both [僧祐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E7%A5%90) Sēngyòu and the Tang catalogs (*[Lìdài sānbǎo jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0011)*, *[Kāiyuán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0093)*) list the text as 失譯 ("lost translator"). Modern scholarship has generally placed it on stylistic grounds in the southern Liú-Sòng period, but no firmer dating is possible. The text is shorter and more compact than [T632](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0269) and may represent a separate Indic recension rather than a retranslation of the same source. Together with T632 and [T634](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0271), T633 forms the Chinese tradition of the "wisdom-seal samādhi" — a doctrinal motif that was later absorbed into tantric Buddhism's mudrā theory.
